title: Assembled by
hint_spec_mapping: The gears the spec plan offers for the capabilities the specifications name: instant, free, the same every time.
hint_gears_matcher: The gears the latest gear match proposes, requirement by requirement: takes minutes, costs model calls, varies between runs.
not_offered: Not available here: the Gears matcher kit is not installed or its service is not set up.
unavailable_kit_not_installed: the Gears matcher kit is not installed in this organization or project (Organization › Kits).
unavailable_kit_unknown: whether the Gears matcher kit is installed could not be read.
unavailable_not_configured: its service is not set up on this deployment ({reason}).
choice_label: How this project's product is assembled
fallback: {chosen} cannot be used here, so {used} is: {reason}
no_match: No gear match yet: run one on the Gear match tab, then propose again.
match_not_finished: The latest gear match has not finished: propose again once it has.
no_finished_match: No gear match has finished yet: the last one {state}. Run one on the Gear match tab, then propose again.
nothing_from_match: The gear match of {date} proposes nothing the product lacks: each gear it proposes is already in the product, was rejected, or is not in the catalogue the product reads.
nothing_to_propose: Nothing to propose: the product already has what this strategy would add.
pending: {strategy} proposes these gears; the engine's completion is shown below. Nothing is added until you confirm.
completion_needs: {gear} needs settings before the product resolves: {settings}. Adding saves it without them; give them on the Product map afterwards.
org_lead: The gears-matcher service reads a project's specifications and says, per requirement, which gears of the catalogue cover it. Here the organization decides how its projects' products are assembled unless a project chooses for itself.
org_may_not: Only an organization administrator changes the default.
org_effective: Projects that follow the default are assembled by {strategy}.
org_not_settable: This deployment keeps no settings for products (no database): every product uses Spec mapping.
fallback_manual: {chosen} cannot be used here, and no other strategy can, so the product is assembled by hand: {reason}
manual_no_kits: No strategy kit is installed here, so nothing proposes gears: pick them yourself on the Product map. Install Spec mapping or Gears matcher under Kits to have them proposed.
org_service_limits: at most {documents} documents, {document} KB each, {request} KB a request
org_default_only: {strategy} is the only strategy installed, so it is the default: there is nothing to choose. Install another strategy kit under Kits to choose between them.
org_default_none: No strategy kit is installed: products are assembled by hand.
usage_error: The usage could not be read: {error}
tile_strategies_note: {matcher} by a matching service, {spec} by Spec mapping, {manual} by hand
tile_tokens_note: {calls} model calls ({cache} from cache), {input} in, {output} out
grid_empty_note: The organization has no project you can open.
coverage_line: {covered} covered, {partial} partial, {gap} gaps, {clarify} to clarify, {not_assessed} not assessed
no_match_service: No {strategy} match yet: run one with Run a match, then propose again once it has finished.
match_started: A {strategy} match is running in Background work: propose again once it has finished.
org_service_runs: {runs} runs in the period, {calls} model calls
service_connect_lead: This strategy comes with one of the organization's kits and runs on a service the organization provides: connect its address and secret. They are kept as a connection, never in the kit.
service_connect_admin: An organization administrator connects its service here.
